text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki has decided to run in the Arima Kinen. Before the race, the caster takes a moment to introduce all the Umamusume who will be running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Oguri Cap doesn't raise her head once during the whole event. She has been out of sorts recently and isn't running like herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her like this, Yaeno Muteki suddenly bolts onto the track mid-event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The commotion draws Oguri Cap's attention, and when she finally looks up, Yaeno gives her a stern reminder that her fans are watching, and it is their support that gives her power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno encourages her to lift her head, and with these words, Oguri Cap's fighting spirit returns. She appears reinvigorated.
